description: This source file implements the SetVolume class, which is responsible for setting the volume of a media stream within a specific context. It includes methods for construction, destruction, and execution of the volume setting operation, utilizing a GstWrapper for interacting with GStreamer.

classes.name: SetVolume
classes.description: A class responsible for setting the volume of a media stream in a given context.
